meta.title: Hartwell & Okafor | Family, Wills and Probate Solicitors, Islington
meta.description: A small Islington law practice for divorce, children arrangements, wills, lasting powers of attorney and probate. Fixed fees where we can. Free 20 minute first call.

rationale: A printed bulletin look suits a practice that has to feel sober and trustworthy: white paper, black ink, one restrained oxblood spot colour, serif headlines and ruled lines, square corners. Ledger, columns and numbered labels let us say plainly what we do and what it costs to ask, while the single repeated call to action keeps the free first call in front of an anxious reader.

props.headline: Clear legal help for the hard moments: divorce, wills and probate.
props.sub: We are a small Islington practice with two partners and a paralegal. We explain things plainly, tell you the cost early, and offer fixed fees wherever we can.

photo.subject: The front of the Islington office on a quiet morning, door and brass nameplate in view, taken at eye level in natural light

props.label: What we do
props.title: Three areas of work, done carefully
props.intro: We keep our practice narrow on purpose. Each matter is handled by a partner, with our paralegal keeping paperwork moving.

items.name: Divorce and separation
items.description: Ending a marriage or civil partnership, agreeing how to divide money and property, and keeping the process as calm as it can be.

items.name: Arrangements for children
items.description: Agreeing where children live and how time is shared, by agreement where possible and through the court only when needed.

items.name: Wills
items.description: Wills written in plain English, so your wishes are clear and your family is protected.

items.name: Lasting powers of attorney
items.description: Choosing someone you trust to make decisions for you if you are ever unable to, and putting it in place properly.

items.name: Probate
items.description: Helping executors and families deal with an estate after a death, step by step and without jargon.

items.name: First call
items.description: A free conversation to hear your situation and explain your options and likely costs. No obligation.

props.note: Where we can, we quote a fixed fee before work begins. Where a matter cannot be fixed, we explain why and give you an estimate.

props.label: How it works
props.title: What happens when you get in touch

pairs.ask: I do not know where to start.
pairs.answer: Book the free 20 minute call. You tell us what has happened, we listen, and we explain your options in plain English.

pairs.ask: How much is this going to cost?
pairs.answer: We tell you before you commit. Where the work allows it, we agree a fixed fee in writing.

pairs.ask: What do you need from me?
pairs.answer: Only the documents that matter for your case. We give you a short list, and our paralegal helps you gather them.

pairs.ask: Who will be dealing with my case?
pairs.answer: One of the two partners, Clare Hartwell or Tunde Okafor, from the first call to the end.

props.label: About us
props.title: A small practice, on purpose
paragraphs: Hartwell & Okafor is run by two partners, Clare Hartwell and Tunde Okafor, with the help of a paralegal. We work from Islington and see clients who are, more often than not, meeting a solicitor for the first time.

Most people come to us at a hard moment: a marriage ending, a parent who has died, a decision about the future that cannot wait. Many are worried about what it will cost. That is why we offer fixed fees where we can, and a free first call so you can ask questions before you spend anything.
We would rather explain a thing twice than leave you unsure. We write to you in ordinary language, we tell you what happens next, and we do not hurry you.
props.pullQuote: We would rather explain a thing twice than leave you unsure.

quotes.text: I was dreading the first call. Twenty minutes later I knew what my options were and what it would cost.
Everything was explained without jargon, and the fee was the fee we were quoted at the start.
quotes.who: Client, will and power of attorney

quotes.text: Dealing with my mother's estate felt impossible. They told me the next step each time, and that was enough.

props.label: Questions
props.title: Questions people ask before they call

items.q: Is the first call really free?
items.a: Yes. The first call lasts 20 minutes and costs nothing. There is no obligation to instruct us afterwards.
Where we can, yes. We will tell you on the call whether your matter can be done for a fixed fee, and put the figure in writing before we start.

items.q: What areas of law do you cover?
items.a: Family law (divorce, separation and arrangements for children), wills, lasting powers of attorney, and probate. If your matter is outside these, we will say so and point you elsewhere.
A partner, Clare Hartwell or Tunde Okafor. Our paralegal helps with documents and keeping your matter moving.

items.q: Do I need to come to the office?
items.a: You are welcome to, and the office is in Islington. Please ask when you book if you would prefer to talk by telephone.

props.label: Contact
props.title: Book your free first call
props.address: Hartwell & Okafor, 14 Upper Street, Islington, London N1 0AA
props.directions: A short walk from Angel station and Highbury & Islington station. Step-free access to be confirmed.
